name: @sos-2/runtime-conformance
description: SOS 2.0 runtime conformance evidence: a RuntimeViewAdapter contract consuming @sos-2/telemetry raw observations, evaluating declared executable invariants (@sos-2/conformance invariant DSL over @sos-2/architecture graphs) at an exact SystemState revision, and emitting typed Evidence records (kind Evidence, truthful availability, PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN never conflated) with OBSERVES/VERIFIES trace links (spec/architecture.md sections 7 and 18, R8/R21/R23/R30).
